description: Minor, patch, digest and pin updates are automerged via GitHub auto-merge once CI (build, vet, staticcheck, unit and MySQL 8.0/8.4 acceptance tests) and the review requirement pass.
Major updates and Go toolchain bumps stay manual, except majors of GitHub Actions that PR CI exercises, which are automerged.
Actions used only by release.yml (goreleaser/goreleaser-action, crazy-max/ghaction-import-gpg) stay manual because PR CI does not run the release pipeline.
Updates must be at least 3 days old before Renovate proposes them (minimumReleaseAge).
GitHub Actions are pinned to commit SHAs (helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests) so tag moves cannot inject code.

packageRules.description: Automerge low-risk updates; majors are intentionally not matched.
Automerge GitHub Actions majors: the workflows PR CI runs (test.yml, labeler, release-drafter) prove them.
Release-only actions are used solely by release.yml, which PR CI does not exercise, so their majors stay manual (must come after the major automerge rule to win).
Go toolchain bumps change the supported/built Go version; review manually.
